item.title: PortWin 1.29
item.description:
• The free trial is now 7 days. If you started your trial before this update, you keep your 14 days.
  • When a program can't find one of its own files (a DLL that is part of the program, not a Windows component), PortWin says so and suggests running it from the folder where the program is installed, instead of offering Fix Automatically, which can't help here.
  • After Fix Automatically, "Last run" and the problem report show the program's own failure again — not the Windows version that PortWin set back.
  • A hint when macOS hasn't allowed PortWin to access external drives, with a button that opens the right settings.
  • Programs built for Windows Vista or later in a Windows XP bottle: a one-click "Windows 10 for this program".
  • Per-program Windows version now works for programs added as shortcuts.
  • A .NET crash of another process in the bottle is no longer reported as a crash of your program.
